# The (un)Stable Net

> Weekly briefs on European equities, macro signals, technology and AI by Jacopo Berton — clear, actionable analysis with no noise.

The main product of The (un)Stable Net is the weekly newsletter "European Market Movers" at /newsletter — macro signals, sector rotations and the numbers that move European portfolios. Alongside it there are long-form articles on markets, tech and AI, plus smaller side projects.

## Pages

- [Newsletter — European Market Movers](/newsletter): The site's main product. Every weekly issue on European equities, macro signals, sector rotations and AI-driven market shifts.
- [Subscribe](/subscribe): Sign up for the weekly European Market Movers newsletter.
- [Archive](/archive): Full archive of newsletter issues and articles, filterable by year and tag.
- [Articles](/articles): Latest published articles across markets, tech and AI.
- [Home](/): Overview of the project and active initiatives.
- [About](/about): Who Jacopo is and what the project is about.
- [Contribute](/contribute): Submit a guest article or pitch.
